domains.title: Domains
domains.description: One per line: example.com, www.example.com or a full URL (only the domain is used). Each homepage is fetched once. Leave the three filters below empty to get every site's full tech stack, one row per site, like Wappalyzer.

requireAll.title: Must use all of
requireAll.description: Keep only sites using every one of these, e.g. "Shopify", "Klaviyo". Names are forgiving: "woocommerce", "google analytics", "GA4" all work. Leave all three filters empty to keep every site.

requireAny.title: Must use at least one of
requireAny.description: Keep only sites using at least one of these, e.g. "Shopify", "WooCommerce", "BigCommerce". Clear it (and leave the other two filters empty) to get the tech stack of every site you list.

exclude.title: Must not use
exclude.description: Drop sites using any of these. Example: require Shopify and exclude Klaviyo to find stores without Klaviyo.

enrich.title: Add contact details
enrich.description: For matching sites, read the contact and about pages (at most 2 extra pages) for the business emails, phone numbers and social profiles they publish. Addresses that look like a staff member's own are left out.

includeNonMatches.title: Include non-matching sites
includeNonMatches.description: Also output sites that didn't match, or couldn't be loaded, with the reason. These rows are free. With no filters this is automatic: every site gets a row.

maxItems.title: Max matching sites
maxItems.description: Stop once this many matching sites have been found.
